scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a pedestrian area with buildings on both sides, including a large yellow building on the left and a modern glass-fronted building on the right. The street is paved with cobblestones and has a sidewalk on the right side. A woman wearing a black puffy jacket walks along the sidewalk, passing by a set of stairs leading down to a subway station. The sky is partly cloudy.
scene_analysis.buildings: The yellow building has a classic design with arched windows and balconies, while the modern building has a sleek glass frontage with a flat roof. The street is lined with cars parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.materials: The yellow building has a stone base and a cream-colored facade with a mix of rectangular and arched windows. The modern building has a smooth glass frontage with a flat roof.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked near the entrance to the subway station.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are some small trees and bushes planted along the sidewalk, adding some greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the sidewalk, including a large digital display showing information about the subway system.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is bustling with activity, with people going about their daily business.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is a popular destination for those looking for a quick bite to eat or a place to meet friends.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a great spot for sightseeing and exploring the surrounding neighborhood.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is a great place to relax and unwind after a long day.
